entries.basis: Variant: Ultra AWD EM-i, the Paris show car (no European spec sheet or price). 1,100 km combined and 130 km electric (29.8 kWh) per CarNewsChina's Paris preview, cycle not stated (elektroquatsch calls the 130 km NEDC); 30-80% in 15 min per elektroquatsch; 0-100 in 5.83 s (CnEVPost, Egypt launch); wheelbase 2,845 mm. Driver-assist hardware is not published in any page opened, so assistance is null; no European price (Egypt is EGP only), so value is null. Doubt: elektroquatsch lists 250 kW system output vs 305 kW in the CarNewsChina preview. Charging revised: e-AWD 29.8 kWh pack rated up to 78 kW DC, 30-80% in about 15 min (CAR Magazine/Geely reference spec, NEDC-era figures, EU homologation pending); scored on peak power.
